posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I've made myself a little challenge: one fight against each villain, in each environment twice (minus two...), with heroes randomly selected, while each has to be used once before they can be used again. The first few rounds...

Freedom Six Tachyon, Nightmist, Captain Cosmic and Guise held their own against Progeny at the Block, and I'm not being funny when I say it was mostly thanks to Guise.

Omnitron-U, Dark Watch Mister Fixer and Absolute Zero make a surprisingly good team versus the Matriarch (would've been better if any modules had shown up!), but the Thorathian war took its toll on them in short order.

Try as they might, Engine of War Bunker, Fanatic, Sky-Scraper and Elemental Wrath Absolute Zero could not withstand the flying assault of Iron Legacy, even with the help of Enclave of the Endlings. (AZ and Bunker put on an amazing show though, no lie.)

Total Games: 79
